Settings.Token.Label: Musixmatch User Token
Settings.Token.Desc: Optional. Leave empty to let the plugin fetch and cache a token automatically.
Settings.TranslationLanguage.Label: Translation Language
Settings.TranslationLanguage.Desc: ISO language code for line translations fetched from Musixmatch (e.g. pt, en, es). Use 'none' to disable.
Settings.PreferWordByWord.Label: Prefer Word-by-word Lyrics
Settings.PreferWordByWord.Desc: When available, use Musixmatch's word-by-word (richsync) timing instead of line-only synced lyrics.
